tasks.answer: flight-delay.FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen (FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen) is the batch compensation workspace covering standard, special and review steps. It requires batchId, needs query/auth/router providers, and handles offline/conflict states.

Search found only the generic traveler booking list; no dedicated 'special passenger booking list' variant is exposed in the catalog. Use bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen (TravelerBookingListScreen), a paginated traveler booking list with search and filters. Required prop: navigate; initialStatus is optional and permission-gated.

auth.PasswordInput (PasswordInput) has show/hide labels and must be used inside UiFormField. Errors are surfaced as a string rendered by the field wrapper (form-field error), not by PasswordInput itself.

SearchBar: business.SearchBar, required props value, placeholder, onChange (optional onFilter adds the filter icon button). FilterSheet: business.FilterSheet, required props visible, title, children, onClose (onConfirm runs before the sheet closes). Both are shared-ui components imported from @/components/business/mobile.

common.AuthRecoveryDialog (AuthRecoveryDialog) is the global auth recovery dialog. Mount it once near the app root; it subscribes to the auth recovery store, lazily renders its view, and renders null while no recovery event is pending.

notes: Five search calls (one per task, --limit 3 --details) plus one get for task 2 (bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen) to check for a special-passenger variant; the get exposed only navigate (required) and initialStatus (optional), with no variant field. No project files were read or modified; only catalog CLI output was used. catalogCalls counts all component-catalog invocations: 5 search + 1 get = 6.
